newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK industrial production index down 3.6 pct in Q2.
newsitem.headline: HK industrial production index down 3.6 pct in Q2.

text.p: Hong Kong's index of industrial production decreased by 3.6 percent in the second quarter of 1996, the Census and Statistics department said on Tuesday.
Textiles output was down 7.8 percent and that of electrical and electronic products, machinery, professional equipment and optical goods fell 3.9 percent.
Consumer electrical and electronic products output decreased 11.8 percent. Chemicals, rubber, plastic and non-metallic mineral products output fell 1.5 percent.
Food, beverages and tobacco output decreased 3.7 percent while paper products and printing output was down 4.4 percent.
Output of machinery, equipment, apparatus, parts and components rose 4.0 percent.
Production of wearing apparel, except footwear, was down 2.8 percent. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
